pages.text: God told Jonah, "Go to the big city of Nineveh and tell the people to be sorry for their sins." But Jonah did not want to go, so he boarded a ship going the other way.
A huge storm came, and the ship shook. Jonah told the sailors, "I am running from God. Throw me into the sea, and the storm will stop." They did, and the sea became calm.
God sent a great fish to swallow Jonah. Inside, Jonah prayed, "Thank you, God, for saving me!" After three days, the fish spat Jonah onto dry land.
This time Jonah obeyed and went to Nineveh. He told the people to turn back to God. They listened and were sorry, and God forgave them.
Jonah was grumpy that God was so kind. God grew a plant to shade him, then asked, "Should I not care about all the people of Nineveh?" God cares about everyone.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: God forgave the people of Nineveh, and God forgives us. We should forgive others, too.
